assertions.assertion: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is performed with CPT code 93229
The member has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnosis code I25.10 is assigned
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess for ischemic changes
The documented indication R00.2 supports the service
The denial is based solely on the missing prior authorization CO-197
Securing valid authorization does not preclude coverage
The service remains eligible when authorization is obtained
